name: ACA 521 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto, you are at gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS T, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 521，从 Wuhan 到 Toronto，位于 232 号登机口，已收到最新 ATIS T，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA 521, gate 232, information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，ACA 521，232 号登机口，信息 T，请求前往 Toronto 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: ACA 521, cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb to 1,500 meters, Z FOXTROT-05 departure, cruising level 10,400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 521，许可按飞行计划航路飞往多伦多，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1,500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 10,400 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 1400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往多伦多，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 1400 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 521, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 521，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway A3, you confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你看到前方滑行道 A3 上有障碍物，向武汉地面确认滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 521, there is an obstruction ahead of us on A3, confirm the taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 521，A3 上我们前方有障碍物，请确认滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, hold at present position, the ground handling will deal with it.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，原地等待，地面保障会处理。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，障碍物已移除，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point Runway 04, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point E5 Runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 521, holding at holding point E5 Runway 04, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 521，在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，地面风 030 度 8 节。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters, make an initial contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米，与 Wuhan Departure 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 521, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 521，通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, radar contact, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，雷达识别，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above your level, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在你高度上方 300 米，向武汉管制确认是否与你的飞机冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 521, our TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above our level, is it in conflict with us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 521，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在我们高度上方 300 米，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, negative, it is parallel to your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，否，它与你的航迹平行。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make an Urgency call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，机长突然心脏病发作，向武汉管制发出紧急呼叫并请求立即返航优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 521, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 521，机长突然心脏病发作，请求立即返航优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, roger PAN PAN, turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，收到 PANPAN，左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，ACA 521。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 521, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 521，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要救护车和医生。
cards.referenceText: Request an ambulance and a physician, ACA 521.
